title: Seagrove Beach Cottage | KEY.co
meta_description: An exclusive beach setting in Seagrove
description_expanded: This delightful floor plan provides four bedrooms, which include a bonus sleeper room. Immerse yourself in sensational Gulf views from the second-floor living-kitchen-dining area. The third-floor primary suite and large bathroom capture the sparkling white sandy beach. On the first floor, you'll find a bedroom and bath plus an entertainment room with a wet bar. It provides easy access to the beach walkover. A separate bedroom and large bath are also located on the first floor. Seagrove Beach Cottage sits on 57 feet of stunning beach frontage. Your boardwalk access borders the home itself and takes you through a secluded tree arbor atop a high dune. Below you'll find a quieter beach with room to throw a ball with the family. A freshly updated renovation was completed in 2022. All new furnishings and a coastal contemporary look make this a great family getaway on a quiet beach. Seaside is an easy bike ride. This convenient location is centrally located to all of 30A.

Features: Indoor Air conditioning Internet TV Deck
Parking information- Private driveway parking available
